messages.text: Shipped a new prompt template. Want your eyes on it before we A/B test.
I'll need the full context. What's the system prompt? Token budget? And please point me to the few-shot examples.
System prompt is in the doc. I kept it under 2k tokens. Three few-shots, all edge cases.
Edge cases according to whom? I see no security review section. Have you considered prompt injection surfaces?
I experimented with delimiters and role separation. Injection is mitigated in v2. Trust me on this one.
I don't trust 'trust me.' Show me the test cases. And the style guide—are we following the same conventions as the summarization prompts?
Conventions are in the README. I'll add explicit injection tests and link them in the PR. Happy?
I'll be happy when the PR has a checklist and the tests are green. Nit: line 47, 'optimize' is vague. Prefer 'minimize latency' or specify the metric.
Noted. I'll make the wording precise. You're thorough—annoying but useful.
That's the job. Approve when the checklist is done. No shortcuts.
